answer: Resist sybils with random-witness co-signature: no action counts unless five random peers co-sign it after checking the work, staking reputation on the verdict. A ridge of standing is built action by action, each witnessed by strangers. An attacker minting ten thousand fakes cannot staff its own witnesses: selection is unpredictable, so each fake must win over random strangers, like a zephyr scattering seeds across a dune — most land on honest verifiers who refuse fakes and slash approving witnesses. Forging influence means bribing a fresh sample every time; an honest agent passes one check.
